title: Module 23: Introduction to Financial Statement Analysis

prompt.text: Ratios are an input into which step in the financial statement analysis framework?

feedback.neutral:
C is correct. Ratios are an output of the process information step but are an input  
into the analyze/interpret data step.

prompt.text:
Which phase in the financial statement analysis framework is most likely to involve  
producing updated reports and recommendations?

choices: Develop and communicate conclusions and recommendations

feedback.neutral:
A is correct. The follow -up phase involves gathering information and repeating  the 
analysis to determine whether it is necessary to update reports and  
recommendations.

prompt.text: Which of the following best describes the role of financial statement analysis?

choices: To provide information about a company’s performance
To provide information about a company’s changes in financial position
To form expectations about a company’s future performance and financial position

feedback.neutral:
C is correct. In general, analysts seek to examine the past and current performance 
and financial position of a company to form expectations about its future  
performance and financial position.

prompt.text: The primary role of financial statement analysis is best described as:

choices: providing information useful for making investment decisions.
evaluating a company for the purpose of making economic decisions.
using financial reports prepared by analysts to make economic decisions.

feedback.neutral:
B is correct. The primary role of financial statement analysis is to use financial  
reports prepared by companies to evaluate their past, current, and potential  
performance and financial position for the purpose of making investment, credit, and 
other economic decisions.

prompt.text: International Financial Reporting Standards are currently developed by which entity?

feedback.neutral:
B is correct. The International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) is currently  
charged with developing International Financial Reporting Standards.

prompt.text: US GAAP are currently developed by which entity?

feedback.neutral:
B is correct. US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles are developed by the  US 
Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB).

prompt.text: A core objective of the International Organization of Securities Commissions is to:

choices: ensure that markets are fair, efficient, and transparent.

feedback.neutral:
C is correct. A core objective of IOSCO is to ensure that markets are fair, efficient, 
and transparent. The other core objectives are to reduce, not eliminate,  systemic 
risk and to protect investors, not all users of financial statements.

prompt.text: What type of audit opinion is preferred when analyzing financial statements?

feedback.neutral:
C is correct. An unqualified opinion is a “clean” opinion and indicates that the financial 
statements present the company’s performance and financial position  fairly in 
accordance with applicable accounting standards.

prompt.text:
An auditor determines that a company’s financial statements are prepared in 
accordance with applicable accounting standards except with respect to inventory  
reporting. This exception is most likely to result in an audit opinion that is:

feedback.neutral:
B is correct. A qualified audit opinion is one in which there is some scope limitation or 
exception to accounting standards. Exceptions are described in the audit report with 
additional explanatory paragraphs so that the analyst can determine the importance 
of the exception.

prompt.text: An independent audit report is most likely to provide:

choices: absolute assurance about the accuracy of the financial statements.
reasonable assurance that the financial statements are fairly presented.
a qualified opinion with respect to the transparency of the financial statements.

feedback.neutral:
B is correct. The independent audit report provides reasonable assurance that the  
financial statements are fairly presented, meaning that there is a high probability  
that the audited financial statements are free from material error, fraud, or illegal  
acts that have a direct effect on the financial statements.

prompt.text: Interim financial reports released by a company are most likely to be:

feedback.neutral:
B is correct. Interim reports are typically provided semiannually or quarterly and  
require certain financial information, including unaudited financial statements and an 
MD&A for the interim period covered by the report. Unqualified refers to a type of 
audit opinion.

choices:
Management discussion and analysis

feedback.neutral:
B is correct. When performing financial statement analysis, analysts should review all

prompt.text:
For a company issuing securities in the United States to meet its obligations under 
the Sarbanes–Oxley Act, which of the following is management required to attest to?

choices: The adequacy of internal control over financial reporting
The suitability of management and director compensation agreements

The accuracy of estimates and assumptions used in preparing the financial 
statements

feedback.neutral:
A is correct because the [Sarbanes-Oxley] act addresses auditor independence (it 
prohibits auditors from providing certain non -audit services to the companies they 
audit); strengthens corporate responsibility for financial reports (it requires 
executive management to certify that the company's financial reports fairly present 
the company's condition); and requires management to report on the effectiveness 
of the company's internal control over financial reporting (including obtaining 
external auditor confirmation of the effectiveness of internal control).

prompt.text: Which of the following reports is least likely to be filed with the US SEC?

feedback.neutral: A is correct because the annual report is not a requirement of the US SEC.

prompt.text: Interim reports most likely:

choices: include a full set of financial statements and notes.

feedback.neutral:
B is correct. Interim reports are provided semi -annually or quarterly, depending on 
applicable regulatory requirements.

prompt.text:
Which of the following statements is most accurate about the responsibilities of an 
auditor for a publicly traded firm in the United States? The auditor must:

choices:
state that the financial statements are prepared according to generally accepted 
accounting principles.
ensure that the financial statements are free from error, fraud, or illegal acts.

express an opinion about the effectiveness of the company’s internal control 
systems.

feedback.neutral:
C is correct. For a publicly traded firm in the United States, the auditor must express 
an opinion as to whether the company’s internal control system is in accordance with 
the Public Accounting Oversight Board, under the Sarbanes –Oxley Act. The opinion 
is given either in a final paragraph in the auditor’s report or as a separate opinion.

prompt.text:
Common-size financial statements are most likely a component of which step in the 
financial analysis framework?

feedback.neutral:
C is correct. Preparing common-size financial statements is part of the process data 
step.

described as the role of:

performance of a company, its financial position, and changes in financial position that 
is useful to a wide range of users in making economic decisions.

prompt.text:
Where might an analyst look for details covering the full extent of a company’s capital 
resources?

feedback.neutral:
C is correct because in the MD&A, management must highlight  any favorable or 
unfavorable trends and identify significant events and uncertainties that affect the 
company’s liquidity, capital resources, and results of operations. The MD&A must also 
provide information a bout off -balance-sheet obligations and about contractual 
commitments, such as purchase obligations.

prompt.text: Notes to financial statements most likely include:

choices: an auditor’s opinion as to the fair presentation of the financial statements.
supplementary information about accounting policies, methods, and estimates.

a discussion of significant trends, events, and uncertainties that affect the 
operating results.

feedback.neutral:
B is correct because the notes also disclose information about the accounting policies, 
methods, and estimates used to prepare the financial statements.

prompt.text: A disclaimer of opinion is issued when an auditor:

choices: is unable to issue an opinion.
notes an exception to accounting standards.
finds a material departure from accounting standards.

feedback.neutral:
A is correct because a disclaimer of opinion occurs when auditors are unable to issue 
an opinion.

prompt.text:
Which of the following opinions is the best indication that the auditor believes that 
the financial statements depart materially from accounting standards and are not 
fairly presented?

feedback.neutral:
A is correct because an adverse audit opinion is issued when an auditor determines 
that the financial statements materially depart from accounting standards and are 
not fairly presented.

prompt.text: A qualified audit opinion is most likely issued when financial statements are prepared:

choices: with material departures from accounting standards.
with some limitation or exception to accounting standards.

feedback.neutral:
C is correct because financial statements showing “scope limitation or exception to 
accounting standards” will earn a qualified opinion.

prompt.text:
Common-size statements are most likely the output of which of the following phases 
of the financial statement analysis framework?

choices: Develop and communicate conclusions and recommendations

feedback.neutral:
A is correct because common-size statements are an output of the “process data” 
phase of the financial statement analysis framework.

prompt.text: Which of the following is most likely found in the management commentary?

choices: Basis of preparation for the financial statements

Reasonable assurance whether the financial statements as a whole are free from 
material misstatement

prompt.text:
Which of the following is most appropriately issued when an auditor determines that
